CityBlast is a social media posting service for real estate agents. Starting around $83/month on an annual plan, CityBlast writes and schedules curated industry articles and generic real estate tips to Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn. But the content is not custom-designed for your brand, your market, or your audience. There is no video editing, no custom local graphics, and no client dashboard to manage your content.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The core question is simple: do you want generic posts that blend in, or custom content that builds your brand? Here is how they compare across every category that matters.
